[*]Minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[*]HOTFIX: Local coop controls were not mapping correctly in some circumstances [i](thanks user sb_prime)[/i]

notes.title: About Bots & Belts
notes.content:
For the Steam Games Festival (June 16th-22nd), we are featuring a short playable demo of [b]Bots & Belts[/b]. The demo consists of three levels that will introduce controls and the core gameplay. These levels can be played multiplayer, local co-op, or solo!

The full version of the game will be releasing late this year. It features 27 unique levels, a storyline, a boss, an original soundtrack, as well as unlockable robots and color palettes for your robots.

The idea for [b]Bots & Belts[/b] came about several years ago. It originally began as a 2D game with pixelated characters. We decided that we wanted a multiplayer experience and 3D would lend itself better to the fast-paced gameplay. Many of the original ideas were scrapped but several remain to this day (including the main character!). Check out this screen capture of the original concept:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O8z5NKx.jpg[/img]
[i]Original Game Concept from 2012[/i]

[h3]Bots & Belts is our first standalone release on Steam and we are very excited for players to get their hands on the demo. We appreciate any feedback you can provide us![/h3]

To continue following development please [url=https://www.botsandbelts.com/]visit our website[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/gKY7tzW]join our Discord channel[/url]!
